explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/373: Surányi conjectured that the only non-trivial solution of a!b! = n! is 6!7! = 10!. The statement says the set of (n, a, b) with n! = a!b!, n, a, b > 1, b ≤ a and a + 1 ≠ n is exactly {(10, 7, 6)}. Excluding a = n − 1 removes the trivial b! = n family, and a = n would force b ≤ 1. Faithful.
